items.title: No deal announced after Trump meeting to make 'final determination' on Iran
items.description: The US president met his advisers, after officials confirmed the US and Iran had agreed a framework of a deal.

items.title: US not 'turning back' on Asia allies, but expects them to boost defence - Hegseth
items.description: The US defense secretary is questioned about US commitment, including further arms deals, at an Asian security summit in Singapore.

items.title: 'Poison seller' who sold toxic chemicals online to people across world admits aiding suicides
items.description: Kenneth Law admitted charges relating to Canadian victims - but families say he should also be charged in the UK over 79 deaths in Britain.

items.title: Nato and EU condemn Russia after drone hits Romanian residential block
items.description: Romania says the Russian drone was likely hit over Ukraine by its air defences and altered its trajectory.

items.title: First of five men found alive in flooded Laos cave rescued
items.description: The bedraggled man was led to safety by rescuers after nine days stranded in the cavern

items.title: Ghana parliament passes anti-LGBTQ+ bill
items.description: Same-sex acts are punishable by jail terms under Ghana's new bill targeting those identifying as gay, lesbian or transgender.

items.title: Spain's Sánchez digs in after eight years as PM as wave of scandals threatens survival
items.description: Corruption probes of colleagues and relatives have put Spain's premier into a fight for survival.

items.title: Israel put on UN sexual violence in warzones blacklist for first time
items.description: Israel says it rejects allegations in a new report by the office of the UN secretary general.

items.title: Exploding rocket casts doubts over Nasa's Moon plans
items.description: Explosion of Blue Origin rocket is a setback for the company and for Nasa's Moon plans.

items.title: Former US attorney general Pam Bondi defends her handling of Epstein files in congressional probe
items.description: The testimony comes about a month after America's top prosecutor was ousted by US President Donald Trump.

items.title: 'Controversial' North Korean invasion setting for next Call of Duty game
items.description: Developer Infinity Ward said the game will be "grounded in the military authenticity" the series is known for.

items.title: Ex-head monk of China's 'kung fu temple' jailed for embezzlement
items.description: Shi Yongxin is sentenced to 24 years in prison for embezzlement and bribery.
